## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 144 captures during December 2021. This provides the activity baseline for the reporting period and supports review of the volume processed through the clinic. The recorded total should be considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes when monitoring site performance.

## Image quality

Of the 144 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.1 per cent. This indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, although the recurring camera issues identified by the clinic lead should continue to be logged with the service desk. Recording these issues will support follow-up and help determine whether further action is required.

## Grading

A total of 42 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 18 days. The clinic should continue to monitor grading timeliness and referable outcomes as part of routine service oversight. Together, these measures provide a clear view of activity, image quality and grading performance for December 2021.
